topic: The blind cricketer who played international matches
hook: He couldn't see the ball — and still played internationally.
script: He couldn't see the ball — and still played internationally. Blind cricket is a real sport with real international matches. Players use a ball with ball bearings inside so they can hear it coming. Teams from 16 nations compete. Batsmen listen for the bounce. Fielders track the sound. Same passion. Same intensity. Zero vision. Follow for cricket facts that change your perspective.
